title: A Blue Lagoon Soak: About $90. China's Volcanic Hot Springs: About $12 | China Travel Expert
description:
A soak at Iceland's Blue Lagoon runs about $90. The same thing in China — a public volcanic hot-spring soak — costs about $12.

Iceland's cheapest Blue Lagoon ticket (the "Comfort" entry) is roughly $82–103. In Tengchong, Yunnan — a town sitting on a volcanic geothermal field — outdoor public hot-spring pools start around ¥88, with most public pools in the ¥80–150 range. That's about $12 for the cheapest soak, the same kind of public geothermal bathing, for a fraction of the price. Autumn and winter are peak hot-spring season in China.

🧭 Expert Tip: skip the pricey resort "package" tickets — buy the plain public open-air pool entry, and go on a cold evening when the steam is at its best.

冰岛蓝湖泡一次约90美元；在中国——云南腾冲的火山地热温泉——露天大众池88元起，大约12美元，同样是公共火山温泉，秋冬正是泡汤季。
